corrections.reason: The printed glyph is በ ('የበለጠ', 'greater than you', translating Ge'ez 'ዘይከብረከ' and matching Col 3 L16 'ካንተ የበለጠ ይሆናል'), which was misread as ሰ.
Both visually on the page and grammatically as the nominative subject of 'ይከውነከ', the word across L27-L28 is 'ክብር' (ending in 6th-order ር, not ረ).

corrections.old_text: ኀሥር ።⟫ ማቴ ፳ ፲፪ ሉቃ ፲፰ ፲፬
corrections.corrected_text: ኀሥር ።⟫ ማቴ ፳፫ ፲፪ ሉቃ ፲፰ ፲፬
corrections.reason: The cross-reference to Matthew 23:12 clearly prints the numeral ፳፫ (23) before ፲፪ (12).
The printed glyph at the end of 'ክብር' has the top-left bend of 6th-order ር, matching the nominative case required by 'ይከውነከ ክብር'.
